title: Search of Marcus Vinicius's house and computer for the tape

tellings.quote: James went there. They searched his whole house, you know. They took his computer to a warehouse in S. Paulo.

plain: In 2018, the house of a man named Marcus Vinicius in Varginha, Brazil, was searched from top to bottom for his video tape, and his computer was taken to a warehouse in São Paulo. A surgeon named Italo Venturelli tells this as he heard it from a man named James Fox, who went there himself: "They searched his whole house." It is told because the tape was believed to hold something people wanted found or kept hidden.
